Let <MATH_0001> be a category endowed with the chaotic topology
(Example <REF_0001>). For every object <MATH_0002> of <MATH_0003>
the functor <MATH_0004> defines a point
<MATH_0005> of <MATH_0006>. Namely, conditions (1) and (2) of
Definition <REF_0002> are immediate as the only coverings
are given by identity maps. Condition (2) holds because
<MATH_0007> and since the topology is discrete
taking sections over <MATH_0008> is an exact functor.
